szoveg_eredeti:
Agents built on ElevenAgents can call patients before a visit, verify their date of birth, and update the appointment directly in the EHR if there’s a change or cancellation.

At some of healthcare’s largest organizations, our forward-deployed engineers embed with internal teams to build and launch agents like these, then help expand them across the organization. Here’s a guide to building an outbound appointment reminder agent:

 https://lnkd.in/g4Zch2jV
